# Igris 2.1.0

- Improved intent routing for tasks, reminders, projects, notes, memory, Wellvell, coding, search, screenshots and chat summaries.
- Task dictation and labelled details preserve pending context. Projects ask for a name first and draft an omitted description from supplied facts before collecting monitoring URLs.
- Long conversations carry compact working notes and important source facts alongside recent turns. The visible transcript remains available within existing storage limits; provider failures use extractive notes.
- Responsive chat tables scroll horizontally without squeezing columns. Follow-up replies offer selectable, reorderable choices and editable description prompts in both apps.

Production Android signing is deferred until after V2.3. The Android Debug APK preserves the existing debug signing identity; phone installation requires the connected device. Final verification evidence is in V2_QA_REPORT.md.
